audience: teams and freelancers who track project time and budgets in Tick

useCases.title: Sum up hours logged on a project
useCases.text: The AI lists time entries in a date range for a project, task or user, and totals the hours, billable or not.

useCases.title: Review open projects and their budgets
useCases.text: The AI lists open or closed projects with budget, billable flag and client, and opens one for total hours entered and its tasks.

useCases.title: See what the team logged last week
useCases.text: The AI lists time entries of all users in a date range with date, hours and notes, and groups them by person.

useCases.title: Log or fix a time entry
useCases.text: The AI logs hours on a task with a note, or changes the hours, notes, date or billed status of an existing entry.

useCases.title: Set up a new client, project and task
useCases.text: The AI creates a client, a project for it, and a task on the project so time can be logged. This needs a Tick administrator.
